description: Corrected the critical scalar parameter initialization bug in the GPT class where `y` and `x0_lambdas` were incorrectly assigned to class variables (`self.y`, `self.x0`) instead of the forward pass parameters (`self.x`, `self.x0`) during the forward pass. This caused the MuonAdamW optimizer to fail initialization on the first step, leading to a crash. By fixing the initialization mapping to `self.x`, `self.x0`, `self.y`, and `self.lm_head` before the forward pass, the optimizer initializes successfully on the first step, restoring the model to a stable val_bpb of 0.9913.
